aesthetic.direction: macOS System Settings idiom — platform-native dark, neo-grotesque-product family expressed through Apple's own settings chrome rather than a bespoke look; the only authored flourish is the per-pane hero card

psychology: Jakob's Law — cloning System Settings' sidebar+form means users already know how to operate a config-dense app; near-zero learning cost, and borrowed OS authority for a tool that rewrites the menu bar
Hick's Law / chunking (Miller-Cowan) — a very large option space is chunked into a flat 9-item sidebar and 3-5-row grouped sections; per-pane hero cards add progressive disclosure
Von Restorff effect — a single blue accent (selection + switches + one primary) against monochrome dark makes the active pane and action pop
Aesthetic-Usability Effect — System-Settings-grade polish buys first-contact trust for a utility making deep, slightly scary OS modifications
Doherty Threshold / feedback — the 'Apply to all' switch plus a live styled-menu-bar preview closes the see-the-result loop immediately

Lineage native but confidence only med because all judgments come from one composite; a real @2x screenshot would confirm and unlock absolute pt.
